name: Panoply Dabbler (Core Occultist)
body:
Your familiarity with implements allowed you to tap into the powers of a panoply.

Prerequisite(s): Amateur Occultist, access to one focus power for every arcane school related to the selected panoply, Int 13, Use Magic Device 1 rank, no levels in a class with the mental focus class feature.

Benefit(s): Select one occultist panoply. You can use one focus power from the selected panoply through your implements, as if it were a focus power you had selected with Dilettante Implementer.
